title: Pattern Fingerprint
description: Schema for pattern fingerprints used in cross-repo eval and architecture drift detection. Captures presence, confidence, and evidence for architectural patterns.

repo.description: Repository name or path that was fingerprinted

dimensions.description: Pattern dimensions detected in the repo. Keys are dimension names (e.g., 'di_pattern', 'error_handling', 'logging').

present.description: Whether this pattern dimension is present in the repo

confidence.description: Confidence score for the presence/absence determination (0.0 = uncertain, 1.0 = certain)

evidence.description: File paths, code snippets, or grep results supporting the presence/absence determination

metadata.description: Additional dimension-specific metadata (e.g., framework version, config values)

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the fingerprint was captured

cache_key.description: Hash or unique identifier for caching this fingerprint (e.g., SHA256 of repo path + git commit SHA)

git_commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the repo when fingerprint was captured (for cache invalidation)

metadata.description: Optional repo-level metadata (e.g., primary language, framework versions, LOC)
